title: On My Way to Home - NASA Scientific Research Registry
scope: Research and design reference only. No runtime gameplay definitions, balancing parameters, clinical protocol or implementation authorization.

methodology.evidence_policy: Primary NASA/JPL/NTRS evidence. Status describes the documented configuration and environment, not guaranteed real-time availability. A future schedule or repository end date is not an achieved milestone.
methodology.date_policy: Publication, update and access dates are distinct. Null means not confirmed; never substitute crawl or acquisition dates. No source newer than the review cutoff is admitted.
methodology.trl_policy: Only an explicit achieved numeric TRL for a defined configuration may populate published_trl. Null means no rating transcribed, not TRL 0. Definitions and review titles do not establish an achieved level.
methodology.design_policy: recommended_game_use, required_supporting_equipment and gameplay_dependencies are engineering-informed DESIGN PROPOSALS, not NASA qualification statements or build instructions.
methodology.applicability_policy: Moon/Mars applicability is a proposed adaptation unless the evidence explicitly identifies that surface as the actual test environment.
methodology.dependency_policy: Cross references are research IDs, never inventory IDs. Links describe enabling relationships, not complete bills of materials or quantities. Energy sources, buffers and startup reserves must be designed independently; regeneration loops cannot bootstrap themselves.

status_definitions.operational: Documented operational use or flight heritage in the stated setting; does not imply lunar or Martian deployment.
status_definitions.demonstrated: Bounded test completed in the named environment; scope and duration remain limited.
status_definitions.in_development: Hardware, integration or a capability is still being developed or qualified. Earlier subsystem demonstrations may exist.
status_definitions.research: An evidence area, experiment, analog, standard or environmental reference; not an operational product.
